headline: South Africa GDP Growth Expands Fiscal Headroom, Godongwana Says
summary: Finance Minister Enoch Godongwana stated that South Africa's GDP lift creates fiscal headroom. However, he warned that the statistical windfall is unlikely to fund infrastructure development.
why: South Africa has been managing high debt levels and budget deficits, making fiscal headroom critical for sovereign credit ratings and public finance stability.

impacts.name: South Africa
impacts.why: Improved fiscal headroom eases sovereign budget constraints, though capital spending remains limited.
